name: Garlicky Chickpea Toasts with Cucumber-Pepper Salsa & Dressed Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons; divide between a large and medium bowl. Set aside the medium bowl for later use.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the large bowl with the lemon juice.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl, along with oil and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash the chickpeas until semi-smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots. Add to the reserved medium bowl with the lemon juice.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the salsa. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place honey, vinegar, and spices in another medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to coat, and set aside.

Divide bread between two large baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Spread toasted bread with smashed chickpeas, then top with salsa.
To serve, divide toasts and tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!
